features.name: Registered in QI ecosystem
features.description: Listed in qi_registry.json with port allocation, path, and status.

features.name: Subjects — say what you actually watch
features.description: A personal interest list (AI, Travel, Retirement, …), each subject being a name plus the words that give it away in a title. Shares its vocabulary with TubeScout so both projects agree on what a subject means.

features.name: One feed for everything you subscribe to
features.description: PlayDeck uses the logins you already saved to open each site's 'from the people I follow' page — YouTube subscriptions first — and lists what your channels posted, in one grid, filterable by subject with one click.

features.name: Honest about what it could not fetch
features.description: Each site reports its own count; a failure names its cause instead of quietly substituting an algorithmic feed. Sites with no listable following page say so.
